title: Survival phrases and spelling
description: Unit 0 check after lessons 3 and 4: keep a conversation going, spell names.

items.question: You didn't understand what someone said. What do you say?
items.explanation: Ich verstehe nicht = I don't understand.

items.question: Someone says 'Danke!' to you. What do you answer?

items.explanation: In a yes/no question the verb comes first: Sprechen Sie Englisch?
ein bisschen = a little. Languages start with a capital letter: Deutsch.

items.text: Wie ist Ihr ___? - Mein Name ist Hayk.
items.explanation: der Name. Nouns always start with a capital letter.
Können with ö; buchstabieren = to spell.

items.instruction: Spell your first name and your city letter by letter, using the German letter names (for example: ha, a, ypsilon, ka). Claude will check it.
items.prompt: Spell your first name and your city the German way.
